Alias.name: Aufzeichnung starten
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMstart ---@desc Startet eine neue Kartenaufzeichnung im aktuellen Raum. ---@desc Der Startraum muss eine Raum-ID per gmcp besitzen. Waehrend der ---@desc Aufzeichnung werden Richtungs-Aliase und der Ziffernblock belegt. AsciiMapper:start()

Alias.name: Aufzeichnung beenden
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMstop ---@desc Beendet die laufende Kartenaufzeichnung. Der erfasste Graph bleibt ---@desc erhalten und kann mit #AMshow angezeigt oder mit #AMsave gespeichert werden. AsciiMapper:stop()

Alias.name: Karte anzeigen
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMshow <name>? ---@desc Zeigt die aktuelle Aufzeichnung als ASCII-Karte (79x79-Box um den ---@desc Startraum). Mit optionalem <name> wird stattdessen eine gespeicherte ---@desc Karte angezeigt. AsciiMapper:show(matches[2])

Alias.name: Karte speichern
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMsave <name> ---@desc Speichert die aktuelle Aufzeichnung unter <name>. Die Region wird, ---@desc falls per gmcp vorhanden, automatisch mitgespeichert. Zusaetzlich ---@desc wird die ASCII-Karte als Textdatei im Spiel-Ordner abgelegt. AsciiMapper:save_map(matches[2])

Alias.name: Karte loeschen
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMdel <name> ---@desc Loescht die gespeicherte Karte <name> samt ihrer Textdatei. AsciiMapper:delete_map(matches[2])

Alias.name: Raum loeschen
Alias.script: ---@pattern #AMdelroom <name> <raumid> ---@desc Entfernt einen Raum aus der Karte <name>. Der Raum wird ueber seine ---@desc gmcp-Raum-ID identifiziert; eine gekuerzte ID genuegt, solange sie ---@desc eindeutig ist. AsciiMapper:delete_room(matches[2], matches[3])

Script.name: AM_init
Script.script:
AsciiMapper = AsciiMapper or MundronClassMethods:new{ _name = "AsciiMapper", _shortname = "AM", _module = "AsciiMapper", _version = "1.0.0", _fixed_version = { MundronClassMethods = "1.1.0" }, config = {}, data = {}, files = { game = { maps = {} } } }
-- Spatial offsets for every movement command. dx grows eastward, dy grows -- southward (screen convention), dz selects the map layer. Directions flagged -- as unmappable still create graph edges, but can not be placed on the grid. function AsciiMapper:dir_map() if not self._dir_map then self._dir_map = { norden = { dx = 0, dy = -1, dz = 0, short = "n" }, osten = { dx = 1, dy = 0, dz = 0, short = "o" }, sueden = { dx = 0, dy = 1, dz = 0, short = "s" }, westen = { dx = -1, dy = 0, dz = 0, short = "w" }, nordosten = { dx = 1, dy = -1, dz = 0, short = "no" }, nordwesten = { dx = -1, dy = -1, dz = 0, short = "nw" }, suedosten = { dx = 1, dy = 1, dz = 0, short = "so" }, suedwesten = { dx = -1, dy = 1, dz = 0, short = "sw" }, oben = { dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = 1, short = "ob" }, unten = { dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = -1, short = "u" }, raus = { dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = 0, short = "raus", unmappable = true }, } end return self._dir_map end
function AsciiMapper:dir_vector(name) local d = self:dir_map()[name] if not d then return nil end return d.dx, d.dy, d.dz end
function AsciiMapper:dir_unmappable(name) local d = self:dir_map()[name] return (not d) or d.unmappable end

Script.name: AM_record_control
Script.script:
function AsciiMapper:start() local rec = self.data.recording if rec and rec.active then self:warn("Es laeuft bereits eine Kartenaufzeichnung. Beende sie zuerst mit #AMstop.") return end local id = table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.id") if not id or id == "" then self:warn("Die Aufzeichnung muss in einem Raum mit Raum-ID starten. Hier gibt es keine.") return end if rec then self:info("Die vorherige, nicht gespeicherte Karte wird verworfen.") end self.data.recording = { active = true, start_id = id, current_id = id, region = table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.domain"), rooms = { [id] = { id = id, short = table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.short") or "" } }, edges = {}, edge_set = {}, } self:create_recording_aliases() self:create_recording_keys() self:register_event("mapping", "gmcp.MG.room.info", function() AsciiMapper:on_room() end) self:info("Kartenaufzeichnung gestartet. Bewege dich, um die Karte zu erfassen.") end
function AsciiMapper:stop() local rec = self.data.recording if not rec or not rec.active then self:warn("Es laeuft keine Kartenaufzeichnung.") return end rec.active = false rec.pending = nil self:kill_recording_aliases() self:kill_recording_keys() self:kill_event("mapping") self:info(f"Kartenaufzeichnung beendet. {len(rec.rooms)} Raeume erfasst. Speichere mit #AMsave <name>.") end
-- Called by the direction aliases/keys: remember the intended direction and -- send the command. The gmcp room event then wires up the graph edge. function AsciiMapper:move(dirname) local rec = self.data.recording if not rec or not rec.active then return end rec.pending = dirname send(dirname) end
function AsciiMapper:on_room() local rec = self.data.recording if not rec or not rec.active then return end local id = table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.id") local pending = rec.pending rec.pending = nil if not id or id == "" then self:warn("Der betretene Raum hat keine Raum-ID und wird nicht in die Karte aufgenommen.") rec.current_id = nil return end if not rec.rooms[id] then rec.rooms[id] = { id = id, short = table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.short") or "" } end local from = rec.current_id if from and from ~= id then self:add_edge(rec, from, id, pending) end rec.current_id = id end
function AsciiMapper:add_edge(rec, from, to, dir) local key = f"{from}|{to}|{dir or '?'}" rec.edge_set = rec.edge_set or {} if rec.edge_set[key] then return end rec.edge_set[key] = true table.insert(rec.edges, { from = from, to = to, dir = dir }) end

Script.name: AM_record_bindings
Script.script:
function AsciiMapper:create_recording_aliases() self:kill_recording_aliases() local rec = self.data.recording local alias_ids = {} for long, d in pairs(self:dir_map()) do table.insert(alias_ids, tempAlias(f"^{long}$", function() AsciiMapper:move(long) end)) if d.short ~= long then table.insert(alias_ids, tempAlias(f"^{d.short}$", function() AsciiMapper:move(long) end)) end end rec.alias_ids = alias_ids end
function AsciiMapper:kill_recording_aliases() local rec = self.data.recording if rec and rec.alias_ids then table.apply(rec.alias_ids, killAlias) rec.alias_ids = {} end end
-- Bind the keypad to the eight compass directions plus up/down/leave so the -- map can be recorded by walking with the numpad, mirroring the Wegeskript. function AsciiMapper:create_recording_keys() self:kill_recording_keys() local rec = self.data.recording local keybinds = { ["7"] = "nordwesten", ["8"] = "norden", ["9"] = "nordosten", ["4"] = "westen", ["6"] = "osten", ["1"] = "suedwesten", ["2"] = "sueden", ["3"] = "suedosten", } local keypad = mudlet.keymodifier.Keypad local key_ids = {} for key, dir in pairs(keybinds) do table.insert(key_ids, tempKey(keypad, mudlet.key[key], f"AsciiMapper:move('{dir}')")) end table.insert(key_ids, tempKey(keypad, mudlet.key.Minus, "AsciiMapper:move('oben')")) table.insert(key_ids, tempKey(keypad, mudlet.key.Plus, "AsciiMapper:move('unten')")) table.insert(key_ids, tempKey(keypad, mudlet.key.Asterisk, "AsciiMapper:move('raus')")) rec.key_ids = key_ids end
function AsciiMapper:kill_recording_keys() local rec = self.data.recording if rec and rec.key_ids then table.apply(rec.key_ids, killKey) rec.key_ids = {} end end

Script.name: AM_maps
Script.script:
function AsciiMapper:save_map(name) local rec = self.data.recording if not rec then self:warn("Es gibt keine aufgezeichnete Karte zum Speichern. Starte mit #AMstart.") return end if rec.active then self:info("Die Aufzeichnung laeuft noch und wird zum Speichern beendet.") self:stop() end local mapobj = { name = name, region = rec.region or table.get(gmcp, "MG.room.info.domain"), start_id = rec.start_id, rooms = deep_copy(rec.rooms), edges = deep_copy(rec.edges), } table.set(self.data, {"maps", name}, mapobj) self:save_game("maps") self:write_map_file(mapobj) self:info(f"Karte '{name}' gespeichert ({len(mapobj.rooms)} Raeume).") end
function AsciiMapper:delete_map(name) if not table.get(self.data, {"maps", name}) then self:warn(f"Es gibt keine Karte mit dem Namen '{name}'.") return end self.data.maps[name] = nil self:save_game("maps") mremove_tlines(self:filename(f"maps/{name}")) self:info(f"Karte '{name}' wurde geloescht.") end
-- Resolve a (possibly shortened) gmcp room id to a single room of the map. -- An exact match wins; otherwise a prefix must be unique. function AsciiMapper:resolve_room(mapobj, partial) if mapobj.rooms[partial] then return partial end local hits = {} for id, _ in pairs(mapobj.rooms) do if string.startswith(id, partial) then table.insert(hits, id) end end if len(hits) == 1 then return hits[1] end return nil, len(hits) end
function AsciiMapper:delete_room(name, partial) local mapobj = table.get(self.data, {"maps", name}) if not mapobj then self:warn(f"Es gibt keine Karte mit dem Namen '{name}'.") return end local rid, count = self:resolve_room(mapobj, partial) if not rid then if count and count > 1 then self:warn(f"Die Raum-ID '{partial}' ist in Karte '{name}' nicht eindeutig ({count} Treffer).") else self:warn(f"Kein Raum in Karte '{name}' passt zur Raum-ID '{partial}'.") end return end mapobj.rooms[rid] = nil local kept = {} for _, e in pairs(mapobj.edges) do if e.from ~= rid and e.to ~= rid then table.insert(kept, e) end end mapobj.edges = kept if mapobj.start_id == rid then mapobj.start_id = next(mapobj.rooms) end if not mapobj.start_id then self:info(f"Der letzte Raum wurde entfernt, Karte '{name}' wird geloescht.") self:delete_map(name) return end self:save_game("maps") self:write_map_file(mapobj) self:info(f"Raum '{rid}' wurde aus Karte '{name}' entfernt.") end

Script.name: AM_assign_coords
Script.script: -- Assign integer grid coordinates {x, y, layer} to every room by propagating -- the direction vectors outward from the start room. Rooms reachable only via -- unmappable edges, or whose position is geometrically inconsistent, are -- flagged "blocked" and later drawn as B instead of O. The full graph is kept -- regardless of whether it can be projected onto the grid. function AsciiMapper:assign_coords(mapobj) local coords, blocked = {}, {} coords[mapobj.start_id] = { x = 0, y = 0, layer = 0 } for _, e in pairs(mapobj.edges) do if not e.dir or self:dir_unmappable(e.dir) then blocked[e.from] = true end end local changed = true while changed do changed = false for _, e in pairs(mapobj.edges) do if e.dir and not self:dir_unmappable(e.dir) then local dx, dy, dz = self:dir_vector(e.dir) local ca, cb = coords[e.from], coords[e.to] if ca and not cb then coords[e.to] = { x = ca.x + dx, y = ca.y + dy, layer = ca.layer + dz } changed = true elseif cb and not ca then coords[e.from] = { x = cb.x - dx, y = cb.y - dy, layer = cb.layer - dz } changed = true elseif ca and cb then if cb.x ~= ca.x + dx or cb.y ~= ca.y + dy or cb.layer ~= ca.layer + dz then blocked[e.from] = true blocked[e.to] = true end end end end end return coords, blocked end

Script.name: AM_draw
Script.script:
-- Write a single character onto the canvas. Rooms are never overwritten, and -- two different edge characters meeting on the same cell become a crossing x. function AsciiMapper:put(grid, x, y, ch) local row = grid[y] if not row or row[x] == nil then return end local cur = row[x] if cur == "O" or cur == "B" then return end local edges = "-|/\\" if cur ~= " " and edges:find(cur, 1, true) and edges:find(ch, 1, true) and cur ~= ch then row[x] = "x" else row[x] = ch end end
-- Connect two canvas cells. Straight runs are filled with - or |, perfect -- diagonals with / or \. Longer-than-unit spans are simply repeated, which is -- how edges get "scaled" to bridge rooms that ended up further apart. function AsciiMapper:draw_edge(grid, x1, y1, x2, y2) local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1 if dy == 0 then for cx = math.min(x1, x2) + 1, math.max(x1, x2) - 1 do self:put(grid, cx, y1, "-") end elseif dx == 0 then for cy = math.min(y1, y2) + 1, math.max(y1, y2) - 1 do self:put(grid, x1, cy, "|") end elseif math.abs(dx) == math.abs(dy) then local sx = dx > 0 and 1 or -1 local sy = dy > 0 and 1 or -1 local ch = (sx == sy) and "\\" or "/" for i = 1, math.abs(dx) - 1 do self:put(grid, x1 + i * sx, y1 + i * sy, ch) end end -- Non-aligned spans are left undrawn; their endpoints are already blocked. end
-- Reduce a rendered layer to at most a 79x79 window that still shows the -- anchor cell (the start room on its layer). function AsciiMapper:clip(lines, ax, ay) local box = 79 local height = len(lines) local width = 0 for _, l in ipairs(lines) do width = math.max(width, #l) end local oy = (height <= box) and 0 or math.max(0, math.min(ay - math.floor(box / 2), height - box)) local ox = (width <= box) and 0 or math.max(0, math.min(ax - math.floor(box / 2), width - box)) local out = {} for r = oy + 1, math.min(height, oy + box) do table.insert(out, lines[r]:sub(ox + 1, ox + box)) end return out end

Script.name: AM_render_layer
Script.script:
-- Render the rooms on a single layer into an array of text lines (clipped to -- the 79x79 box around the anchor). function AsciiMapper:render_layer(mapobj, coords, blocked, layer) local pts, minx, maxx, miny, maxy = {} for id, c in pairs(coords) do if c.layer == layer then pts[id] = c minx = minx and math.min(minx, c.x) or c.x maxx = maxx and math.max(maxx, c.x) or c.x miny = miny and math.min(miny, c.y) or c.y maxy = maxy and math.max(maxy, c.y) or c.y end end local width = (maxx - minx) * 2 + 1 local height = (maxy - miny) * 2 + 1 local grid = {} for r = 1, height do grid[r] = {} for c = 1, width do grid[r][c] = " " end end local function cx(x) return (x - minx) * 2 + 1 end local function cy(y) return (y - miny) * 2 + 1 end -- edges below the rooms for _, e in pairs(mapobj.edges) do if e.dir and not self:dir_unmappable(e.dir) then local ca, cb = pts[e.from], pts[e.to] if ca and cb then self:draw_edge(grid, cx(ca.x), cy(ca.y), cx(cb.x), cy(cb.y)) end end end -- rooms on top for id, c in pairs(pts) do grid[cy(c.y)][cx(c.x)] = blocked[id] and "B" or "O" end local lines = {} for r = 1, height do table.insert(lines, table.concat(grid[r])) end local ax, ay local sc = pts[mapobj.start_id] if sc then ax, ay = cx(sc.x), cy(sc.y) else ax, ay = math.floor(width / 2) + 1, math.floor(height / 2) + 1 end return self:clip(lines, ax, ay) end
-- Build a per-layer rendering of the whole map. Returns the sorted list of -- {layer, lines} blocks and the number of rooms that could be placed. function AsciiMapper:render(mapobj) local coords, blocked = self:assign_coords(mapobj) local layers, seen, placed = {}, {}, 0 for _, c in pairs(coords) do placed = placed + 1 if not seen[c.layer] then seen[c.layer] = true table.insert(layers, c.layer) end end table.sort(layers) local blocks = {} for _, l in ipairs(layers) do table.insert(blocks, { layer = l, lines = self:render_layer(mapobj, coords, blocked, l) }) end return blocks, placed end

Script.name: AM_show
Script.script:
-- #AMshow: print the start layer as a single 79x79 box that contains the -- starting room. Further layers are only noted; the full multi-layer map is -- written to the text file on save. function AsciiMapper:show(name) local mapobj if name then mapobj = table.get(self.data, {"maps", name}) if not mapobj then self:warn(f"Es gibt keine Karte mit dem Namen '{name}'.") return end else mapobj = self.data.recording if not mapobj then self:warn("Es gibt keine aktuelle Karte. Starte eine Aufzeichnung mit #AMstart.") return end end local title = mapobj.name and f"Karte '{mapobj.name}'" or "Aktuelle Kartenaufzeichnung" if mapobj.region and mapobj.region ~= "" then title = f"{title} - Region: {mapobj.region}" end self:info(title) local blocks, placed = self:render(mapobj) local start_block for _, b in ipairs(blocks) do if b.layer == 0 then start_block = b end end if not start_block then self:warn("Der Startraum konnte nicht dargestellt werden.") return end echo(f"=== Ebene 0 ===\n") for _, line in ipairs(start_block.lines) do echo(line) echo("\n") end if len(blocks) > 1 then self:info(f"Es gibt {len(blocks) - 1} weitere Ebene(n). Die vollstaendige Karte steht in der Textdatei.") end local total = len(mapobj.rooms) if placed < total then self:warn(f"{total - placed} von {total} Raeumen sind nicht darstellbar (im Graphen gespeichert).") end end
-- Persist the full, multi-layer ASCII map as a text file in the game folder. function AsciiMapper:write_map_file(mapobj) local lines = { f"Karte: {mapobj.name}" } if mapobj.region and mapobj.region ~= "" then table.insert(lines, f"Region: {mapobj.region}") end table.insert(lines, f"Startraum: {mapobj.start_id}") table.insert(lines, string.rep("=", 40)) local blocks, placed = self:render(mapobj) for _, b in ipairs(blocks) do table.insert(lines, f"=== Ebene {b.layer} ===") for _, l in ipairs(b.lines) do table.insert(lines, l) end table.insert(lines, "") end local total = len(mapobj.rooms) if placed < total then table.insert(lines, f"{total - placed} Raeume konnten nicht dargestellt werden.") end msave_tlines(lines, self:filename(f"maps/{mapobj.name}")) end
